newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.02 rupee up at 42.96 to the dollar on Wednesday in the kerb as players sold the U.S. currency and switched into stocks. Dealers said the rupee was likely to rise further.
They said stocks that surged on the Karachi bourse induced players to sell dollars and invest in the stock market.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 7.0 percent, compared to its previous close of 7.20 percent.
